PRODUCT OVERVIEW

Designed around your signal chain.

The 6U OpenVPX Agilex FPGA is a multichannel transmit and receive platform built around the Agilex 9 AGRW039 device. It combines RF data conversion, processing and programmable logic to support RF acquisition, waveform generation and real-time digital signal processing.

The platform provides 16 RF input channels and 16 RF output channels, with separate DDR4 memory banks for processing and programmable logic. Ethernet, backplane RF connections and synchronization interfaces support integration into radar, phased-array and other multichannel RF systems.

Agilex 9 processing platform: AGRW039 device supports configurable processing and parallel digital signal processing.

16-channel reception and transmission: Sixteen RF inputs and sixteen RF outputs with balun interfaces.

Dedicated processing memory: Separate 16 GB DDR4 banks for the processing system and programmable logic.

Backplane RF connectivity: Four RF input and four RF output connections at P2, with a reference clock connection.

Ethernet connectivity: Dual Gigabit Ethernet interfaces and a 10 Gigabit Ethernet interface.

Synchronization support: External reference and synchronization inputs, onboard clock generation and a backplane synchronization bus.

Flexible storage: QSPI flash, EEPROM, microSD card slot and M.2 SSD interface.

System integration and debug: LVDS, USB 2.0, RS-232/485, JTAG, reset and UART-to-USB connectivity.
